name: button-group
title: Button group
description: Related actions joined into one bar with shared borders and one radius, in a row or a column, stacking on a phone, so a set of buttons reads as a single control.
docs: Give the group an aria-label. variant and size reach every button in it (Button, Copy, Async, Download, Upload and the rest) unless that button sets its own. A child with size="icon" takes the square size of the group, and stackBelow turns a long row into a column on a phone. For choosing a value use Toggle Group or Segmented Control.
